items.title: Shoulder Season Steals Natural Gas Futures $3 Momentum
items.summary: Natural gas futures finished nearly unchanged Friday but posted a sizable weekly loss as rapidly fading power sector demand and the approaching shoulder season outweighed strong LNG feedgas and lower production.

items.title: Scorching Summer Erases Natural Gas Oversupply in Western US
items.summary: Blistering heat across the western United States this summer has massively tightened regional storage balances versus historical norms heading into the shoulder season.

items.title: US LNG Feedgas Demand Climbs to Strongest Level Since Spring
items.summary: Deliveries to US export terminals reached 19.6 Bcf/d Friday, according to NGI’s Entropic Analytics data, the strongest single gas day since late April.

items.title: Winter Premiums Persist in Midwest Despite Ample Natural Gas Storage

items.title: October Natural Gas Futures Wobble as Weather Forecasts Begin Leaning in Bears’ Favor
items.summary: Seasonally strong production readings and forecasts for waning weather demand weighed on New York Mercantile Exchange natural gas futures through morning trading on Friday.

items.title: Canadian LNG Developers Gain New Opening With Ukraine Supply Talks
items.summary: Canada and Ukraine are exploring potential long-term LNG supply agreements as Ottawa expands its push to connect the country’s emerging export sector with European buyers.

items.title: Midwest, East Fortify Natural Gas Storage as Sun Sets on Summer
items.summary: Natural gas stored underground in the Midwest and East — the key regions with large populations that depend on the fuel for winter heating — closed out the summer with ample supply in storage relative to both a year earlier and historical norms.

items.title: ‘Disappointing’ Golden Pass LNG Ramp Trims Winter Natural Gas Demand Outlook
items.summary: Golden Pass LNG’s Train 1 is drawing about a third of its capacity five months into commissioning, as cuts to first-cycle nominations slow the ramp and trim analysts’ natural gas demand outlooks for this winter and early 2027.

items.title: Natural Gas Cash Sinks as Western Strength Unravels
items.summary: Spot natural gas prices retreated across much of the United States Friday as weekend demand eased, with cooler weather spreading into the West and hefty premiums unwinding across the Southeast and South Louisiana.

items.title: U.S. Oil Rig Count Rises as Oil Tops $100
